data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.5m (2017: GBP 3.3m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a prior year reserve movement disclosed as an unfavourable run-off deviation of GBP 0.5m (i.e. a small strengthening of prior year reserves). Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 19.738m. The report provides a gross claims development triangle which shows movements by underwriting year; however an RITC into 2017 is disclosed and the note wording is ambiguous, so the GBP 0.5m movement from the dedicated prior-year movement note is taken as the primary figure.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 0.5m (2017: GBP 3.3m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement taken from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which explicitly states GBP 0.5m. Note wording is contradictory ('unfavourable' vs 'release') so interpretation as an adverse/strengthening movement is applied. A gross claims development triangle is provided and yields a different aggregate movement (~+3.332m) when computed from column diagonals - however an RITC into 2017 (RITC premium GBP 3.1m) is disclosed and may distort the triangle. No explicit gross/net split in the short movement note; assumed gross. Users should treat prior-year movement as low-medium confidence due to wording ambiguity and RITC distortion risk.
